اقتصدتا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَصَدَتَا (iqtaṣadatā) /iq.ta.sˤa.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# اُقْتُصِدَتَا (uqtuṣidatā) /uq.tu.sˤi.da.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
